tasks.label: spell-check
tasks.detail: project files only (git ignored ones are skipped)

tasks.label: check
tasks.detail: format, lint, spell check and test
tasks.command: .venv/bin/python -m ruff format custom_components tests && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && git ls-files -co --exclude-standard | npx -y cspell --no-progress --no-summary --file-list stdin && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -p no:warnings

windows.command: $OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format custom_components tests; if ($?) { .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check . }; if ($?) { git ls-files -co --exclude-standard | npx -y cspell --no-progress --no-summary --file-list stdin }; if ($?) { .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests -q -p no:warnings }

tasks.label: sandbox: deploy
tasks.detail: copy the integration into the sandbox and restart Home Assistant
